config.notes: UOW course pages (www.uow.edu.au/study/courses/...) carry a key-facts panel: "Campus", "Delivery", "Duration", "Starts <session> <year>" (stored view is the current year only, so passed sessions can be missing) and Codes (CRICOS, UOW); the Key dates tab lists each commencing session as "<Session>, <year> at UOW" for this and next year. Intakes = all session names from both, mapped to months from https://www.uow.edu.au/student/dates/ (Autumn=March, Spring=July, Summer=November, Trimester 1/2/3=February/May/August). English table row "IELTS Academic <overall> <bands>". International fees are only a per-session fee and a whole-course fee, so no annual fee is read. Handbook pages (documents.uow.edu.au/handbook/yrYYYY) are archived years and are not read. 5 Oct 13:02 international view: the plain server HTML of www.uow.edu.au/study/courses pages already holds the international content (key facts, key dates, International Course fees table); a rendered ?students=international read of 2 pages gave identical readings, so no page_view is set. The 5 UOW College international-only diplomas (address ?students=international) print no fee, start dates or IELTS even when rendered. International fees are printed only as a session fee and an indicative whole-course fee (2026); no annual fee and no full-time sessions-per-year statement on the course pages. 5 Oct 15:22 checks: no exit-award wording on any stored page. fee_total = the international "Course fee*" (whole-course, indicative, labelled "Total course tuition fees ... based on normal course length") with course_years = the key-facts "Delivery ... Duration N years full-time"; annual = total / years (cross-check: total = session fee x sessions, e.g. 21096 x 6 = 126576 over 3 years). Courses under one year give no fee. entry_requirement = the first sentence of the Academic Entry Requirements block (international view), for review only.
